column1: #mapping_set_description: 'BSgenomeForge seed file: a DCF (Debian Control File) holding everything forgeBSgenomeDataPkg() needs to build a BSgenome data package. Bioconductor keeps its seeds in BSgenomeForge/inst/extdata/seeds/. Two classes share the format: BSgenomeDataPkgSeed (bare sequences) and MaskedBSgenomeDataPkgSeed (masked packages, with RefPkgname and *files_* fields).'
